# 廢廢豬韓國商品報價系統

廢廢豬（fat fat pig）提供韓國商品網址查價與韓幣換算台幣的預估報價，可使用手動試算、檢視費用明細及複製報價內容。

- Homepage: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/
- Bunjang / 번개장터: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/bunjang/
- Naver SmartStore: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/naver-smartstore/
- Musinsa / 무신사: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/musinsa/
- FruitsFamily / 후루츠패밀리: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/fruitsfamily/
- Olive Young / 올리브영: https://korea-quote-0908.vercel.app/olive-young/

Pricing: known product KRW and Korean domestic shipping are converted using the site's current configured quote rate. Proxy fee tiers apply to the product plus known domestic shipping subtotal. Known Korean platform fees are converted separately. Unknown shipping and platform fees remain unknown, are excluded from the estimate, and are clearly disclosed. International shipping is additional. Product options, availability, prices and checkout fees must be checked on the original product source. A global currency amount cannot substitute for a verified Korean KRW price.
